patch_description: Replaces the 146-parameter wire-specific circuit with a symmetry-aware, QAOA-like block using only three shared parameters. Each block alternates a collective RX mixer, two complementary CZ sublayers covering the complete eight-qubit graph, a collective RZ phase layer, and a final collective RY extraction layer. This matches the permutation symmetry of the 28 pairwise features, retains all-to-all interaction coverage, exposes encoded phases to Z readout, and reduces the total model size to 20 parameters for faster, more regularized optimization.
